$comment: Phoneme -> viseme -> facial-action blendshape weight mapping for the RFD 1170 lip-sync stage. Two-stage shape: an ASR/TTS phoneme string picks a viseme, the viseme selects a weighted subset of the 52 facial-action blendshape identifiers ANNY exposes via FACIAL_ACTION_LABELS. Consumer wires viseme weights straight into anny_soma(...) at the frame rate. The mapping is per-frame stateless; blending across frames belongs to the consumer.
phoneme_reference: ARPAbet + IPA hybrid seed; extend as the ASR panel outputs settle. allosaurus universal (RFD 1102 ASR panel row) covers ~700 phones so a real fleet-wide phone inventory replaces this seed in a later refinement.
weight_sources: Placeholder weights derived from Oculus Lipsync and Preston Blair (public references); replace with measured or per-language values in a refinement subset. A phoneme that has no weight measured stays in phonemes.<phoneme> under a viseme that is itself defined here rather than being dropped, so a missing measurement is a named gap not a silent one.
